product.name: Agent Swarm Orchestration
product.promise: Coordinate multiple Codex agents when parallel cognition earns its cost, while preserving one mission, authority envelope, evidence chain, and merge owner.

audience: AI systems designers and technical leads
Non-coder product owners who need safe, legible orchestration

skill_entrypoints.name: agent-swarm-orchestration
skill_entrypoints.activation: Requests to decide, coordinate, recover, or review multi-agent Codex work.

installation_units.state: generated after authoring dispatch; Codex profile PASS; 17-file byte parity with canonical; ZIP has one matching top-level folder and direct SKILL.md

representative_workflows: Decide whether a task earns multiple agents.
Inspect independent repository loci in parallel under read-only authority.
Use one writer plus an independent reviewer for a shared file.
Reconcile conflicting returns against authoritative evidence.
Redirect or interrupt affected workers after a user correction.
Recover a failed worker without restarting accepted work.

validation.validator_tests: 10 passed, including lexical path aliases and malformed nested fields
validation.fresh_context_use: 3 bounded exercises plus 10 isolated natural Codex decision cases at the final fingerprint
validation.codex_release: 17-file exact byte parity with canonical and Codex profile PASS
validation.release_asset: one top-level agent-swarm-orchestration folder, direct SKILL.md, 17 files
validation.codex_behavior: Final fingerprint 8833af96: independent TestForge semantic review passed all 10 isolated natural Codex decision cases; one trial per case; live collaboration tools were not executed
validation.local_model_behavior: Final fingerprint 8833af96 prompted qwen regression: 10 valid episodes, 9 demonstrated, 1 failed; deterministic checker failed the unsupported unchanged-state claim; retained natural-qwen transfer evidence is also negative

known_limits: The skill does not create agent tools or enlarge user authority.
Exact collaboration tool names, schemas, slots, and lifecycle semantics must be read from the live Codex task envelope.
The validator normalizes lexical slash, dot-segment, and case aliases, but does not resolve filesystem-specific aliases, semantic quality, undeclared overlap, or reconciled sequential bytes.
The natural Codex qualification passed all ten decision cases in independent semantic review, but used one isolated trial per case and did not exercise live Codex tools.
Prompted and natural qwen evidence does not establish smaller-model transfer.
Background execution after the Codex task ends is not provided.
Installation, discovery, implicit routing, clean-task invocation, health, and customer outcomes are not established.
Other agent harnesses are outside version 0.1.0.
documentation_requirements: Lead with fit and the shortest route to first value.
Use Codex-only installation and removal guidance; do not mention Claude as a supported host.
Separate canonical source, installable Codex folder, and ZIP release asset.
Include prerequisites, observable success, branches, safe stopping, recovery, and proof of completion.
Describe privacy, authority, agent-report versus verified evidence, single-writer integrity, and tool-contract volatility.
Keep installation, discovery, invocation, health, publication, and customer validation as separate claims.
Provide support, maintenance, change triggers, and removal/rollback.
rights: Original Collaborative Dynamics product; linked sources remain with their owners.
